        <footnote id="F5">These securities are held by Centerbridge Capital Partners II (Cayman), L.P. (&quot;Capital Partners II&quot;).</footnote>
        <footnote id="F6">These securities are held by Centerbridge Capital Partners SBS II (Cayman), L.P. (&quot;Capital Partners SBS II&quot; and, together with Credit Partners, Special Credit Partners II, Credit Partners Master, Special Credit Partners II AIV and Capital Partners II, the &quot;Centerbridge Funds&quot;).</footnote>
        <footnote id="F7">Centerbridge Credit Partners General Partner, L.P. (&quot;Onshore GP&quot;) is the general partner of Credit Partners, and, as such, it may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by Credit Partners. Centerbridge Credit Partners Offshore General Partner, L.P. (&quot;Offshore GP&quot;) is the general partner of Credit Partners Master, and, as such, it may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by Credit Partners Master. Centerbridge Credit Cayman GP Ltd. (&quot;Credit GP &quot;) is the general partner of each of Onshore GP and Offshore GP, and, as such, it may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by Credit Partners and Credit Partners Master.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F8">Centerbridge Special Credit Partners General Partner II (Cayman), L.P. (&quot;CSCPGP II Cayman&quot;) is the general partner of Special Credit Partners II AIV, and, as such, it may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by Special Credit Partners II AIV. Centerbridge Special Credit Partners General Partner II, L.P. (&quot;CSCPGP II&quot;) is the general partner of Special Credit Partners II and, as such, it may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by Special Credit Partners II. CSCP II Cayman GP Ltd. (&quot;CSCP II Cayman Ltd.&quot;) is the general partner of each of CSCPGP II Cayman, and CSCGP II, and, as such, it may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by Special Credit Partners II AIV and Special Credit Partners II.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F9">Centerbridge Associates II (Cayman), L.P. (&quot;CA II Cayman&quot;) is the general partner of Capital Partners II, and as such, it may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by Capital Partners II. CCP II Cayman GP Ltd. (&quot;CCP II Cayman Ltd.&quot;) is the general partner of each of CA II Cayman and Capital Partners SBS II, and as such, it may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by Capital Partners II and Capital Partners SBS II. Mr. Aronson, indirectly, through various intermediate entities controls each of the Centerbridge Funds, and, as such, Mr. Aronson may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by the Centerbridge Funds.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F10">For purposes of this filing, &quot;Reporting Persons&quot; means, as applicable, Special Credit Partners II AIV, Special Credit Partners II, Credit Partners Master, Credit Partners, Capital Partners II, Capital Partners SBS II, Onshore GP, Offshore GP, Credit GP, CSCPGP II Cayman, CSCPGP II, CSCP II Cayman Ltd., CA II Cayman, CCP II Cayman Ltd. and Mr. Aronson.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F11">The filing of this statement by the Reporting Persons shall not be deemed to be an admission that, for purposes of Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise, such Reporting Persons are the beneficial owners of the securities reported herein and each of the Reporting Persons expressly disclaims beneficial ownership of the securities reported herein for purposes of Section 16 of the Securities Act, except to the extent of such Reporting Person's pecuniary interest therein.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F12">The sales reported on this line were effected pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan.</footnote>
